stories.title: Texas Longhorns 2027 Softball — Torres Leads a Major Rebuild

x_posts.label: Post 3-1
x_posts.text:
Texas softball just added the best player in the country.

Isa Torres to the Longhorns:
→ .530 BA (FSU record)
→ D1Softball NPOY
→ ACC POY + Defensive POY
→ 16 consecutive hits (NCAA record)

She's from Georgetown, TX. Coming home. 🤘

#HookEm #Softball

x_posts.label: Post 3-2
x_posts.text:
While Texas gains a generational talent…

FSU loses Torres + Beachum to the portal — that's 28% of their runs, 35% of their HRs, 29% of their hits from 2026.

Lonni Alameda has a rebuild on her hands.

September 1 portal window opens in 33 days.

#Softball #TransferPortal
